Name: (CP) More Buildings for Cute Valley Pink for Content Patcher
Author: BeneathThePlass
Description:
Like many others before me, I'm sure, when I found the [url=https://community.playstarbound.com/threads/content-patcher-cute-valley-1-3-beta.110882/]Cute Valley mod[/url], made by [url=https://community.playstarbound.com/members/rosalie.518048/]Rosalie [/url]on the Chucklefish forums ([i]now also posted [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3499]here on Nexus[/url][/i]), I loved it instantly. The house and stable included in the mod are adorable! I was a little sad, however, at how lackluster the rest of my farm ended up looking in comparison. I mean, how is a girl to tend to her crops when she's distracted by the lack of cuteness in her barns and coops? So, I set out to make matching textures for all the other farm buildings! And, since I put all that work into them, I thought I'd share them for others to enjoy as well!

[b]Included in this mod are the following buildings, done in the pink style of Rosalie's Cute Valley mod;[/b]
[i]Barn
Big Barn
Deluxe Barn
Coop
Big Coop
Deluxe Coop
Fish Pond
Mill
Shed
Big Shed
Silo
Slime Hutch
Well
Interior for Coop/Barn
Interior for Slime Hutch- you have your choice of the vanilla hutch layout, or a slightly extended hutch layout[/i]
[i]

[/i][b]Please note that the original Cute Valley - Pink house & stable is not included in this mod. To get the house/stable, download the original mod [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3499]here[/url] or [url=https://community.playstarbound.com/threads/content-patcher-cute-valley.110882/]here[/url]![/b]


[s]I'm not currently planning on recoloring these for the blue Cute Valley set, unless there's demand for it, since I still have the cabins/slime hutch interior to do, and I also have another texture pack or two in the works. However, as I said in my struck-out text, haha, I would really love to be able to retexture the inside of the slime hutch, but I believe the file for that is a tbin file, and I can't for the life of me figure out how to work with those yet. If anyone could help me out there, I would be so appreciative, you wouldn't even believe.[/s] Thank you, Kuriiyo, for the information regarding tbins!

Hey, good news folks! I finally got around to recoloring this mod for Rosalie's [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3503]Cute Valley Blue[/url]! If you prefer blue to pink, you can find my new [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/15747]More Buildings for Cute Valley Blue[/url] mod over [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/15747]here[/url]﻿!

This expansion pack mod uses the awesome[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915] Content Patcher[/url], by [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/1552317]Pathoschild[/url], so both [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url] and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI[/url] are required for it to work.

More good news folks! I've formatted More Buildings for Cute Valley Pink into a content pack for the fantastic[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915] [/url][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9246]Alternative Textures[/url] mod, and you can find it over [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/15843/]here[/url]!



[b]Installation: [/b]
1. Make sure that you have both [url=https://smapi.io/]SMAPI[/url] and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url] correctly installed in your Stardew Valley folder.
2. Unzip the '[CP] More Buildings for Cute Valley' folder and drop it into your 'Mods' folder in the main SDV game folder.
3. Congrats, you're done and ready to go! Enjoy your new farm!



[b]Credits:[/b]
[list]
[*]Massive credit, of course, to [url=https://community.playstarbound.com/members/rosalie.518048/]Rosalie [/url]﻿on the Chucklefish forums, as they created the original [url=https://community.playstarbound.com/threads/content-patcher-cute-valley-1-3-beta.110882/]Cute Valley mod[/url]﻿ and provided so much inspiration for these textures! Also, a few textures were reused from their houses texture, such as the flower baskets.
[*]The texture for the coop/barn interior floor, and the texture for the slime hutch interior wall was made by [url=https://community.playstarbound.com/members/barfyscorpion.628400/]barfyscorpion [/url]﻿on the Chucklefish forums, and can be found at [url=https://community.playstarbound.com/threads/barfys-fancy-farmhouses-and-other-addons-update-links-are-back-up.112984/]their thread there[/url]﻿- along with a host of other great textures, so go check it out!
[/list]
